sql.customer.getAllByCompany: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, email, phone, company_id from flow.customer where company_id = :companyId;
sql.customer.getById: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_created, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, c.customer_type_id, c.company_id, c.street1, c.city, c.state_id, s.state, c.country_id, ct.country, c.owner_user_position_id, u.id as owner_id, u.first_name as owner_first_name, u.last_name as owner_last_name, p.position as owner_position from flow.customer c inner join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id inner join flow.country ct on ct.id = c.country_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = c.owner_user_position_id left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where c.id = :customerId
sql.customer.getByProjectId: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_created, c.first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, c.customer_type_id, c.company_id, c.street1, c.city, c.state_id, s.state, c.country_id, ct.country from flow.customer c inner join flow.project p on p.customer_id = c.id inner join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id inner join flow.country ct on ct.id = c.country_id where p.id = :projectId
sql.customer.updateCustomer: update flow.customer set customer_type_id = :customerTypeId, first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, street1 = :street1, city = :city, state_id = :stateId, postal_code = :postalCode, country_id = :countryId, phone = :phone, email = :email, mobile = :mobile, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, owner_user_position_id = :ownerUserPositionId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.customer.insertCustomer: insert into flow.customer(customer_type_id, first_name, last_name, street1, city, state_id, postal_code, country_id, phone, email, mobile, created_by_id, company_id) values (:customerTypeId, :firstName, :lastName, :street1, :city, :stateId, :postalCode, :countryId, :phone, :email, :mobile, :createdById, :companyId)
sql.customer.getOwners: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, up.id as position_id, p.position from flow.owner_position_id op inner join flow.user_position up on array[up.position_id] <@ op.position_ids inner join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where op.company_id = :companyId and ARRAY[u.user_status_type_id] <@ ARRAY[ :statusIds ]::integer[] and up.start_date <= now() and (up.end_date is null or up.end_date >= now()) order by u.last_name, u.first_name
sql.customer.updateOwner: update flow.customer set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, owner_user_position_id = :ownerUserPositionId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
